title: Samuel's Farewell Speech and the Thunder Sign
description: Samuel delivers his farewell speech to Israel, defending his integrity and reminding the people of the Lord's history of salvation from Moses and Aaron to the time of the judges. He reminds them that they have rejected God as king by asking for a human king, and sends a divine sign with thunder and rain during the wheat harvest to show the seriousness of their actions. The people are seized with fear and ask Samuel to pray for them, and he promises to continue praying for them and teaching them the right way, but warns that both the people and the king will perish if they do evil.
